description: This Kotlin source file defines the HeroMetricsPresenter class, which creates a custom UI component for displaying a hero card with gauges and a bar strip, used in an Android app for fitness metrics visualization.

classes.name: HeroMetricsPresenter
classes.description: A presenter class that creates a custom hero card with gauges and a bar strip for displaying fitness metrics.

classes.name: HeroData
classes.description: Data class representing the metrics data for the hero card, including activePercent, alerts, energyPercent, and recent activity entries.

methods.name: onCreateViewHolder
methods.description: Creates and initializes the view holder with an ImageCardView configured for the hero card display.

methods.name: onBindViewHolder
methods.description: Binds the HeroData to the view, drawing gauges and a bar strip onto a bitmap and setting it as the card image.

methods.name: onUnbindViewHolder
methods.description: Clears the image bitmap from the view when unbinding.
